headline: Linn of Mercy Erupts as Central Front Casualties Mount
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has erupted into the war's sharpest flashpoint over the past two hours, logging ten rapid base transitions between Lathair and Rotdust and leaving one strategic redoubt reduced to no-man's-land amid over eighteen hundred fresh casualties. In the Weathered Expanse, territorial instability persists with two further base transfers around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, driven by severe combined losses topping thirty-nine hundred dead since the last edition. Meanwhile, the frantic base exchanges in Stonecradle have stalled out over the last two hours, yet fighting remains extraordinarily bloody, consuming over forty-four hundred casualties across contested sectors. To the east, the divided front in Stlican Shelf continues to hemorrhage men, logging over twenty-one hundred casualties in two hours following earlier clashes around Thornhold. Severe pressure is likewise mounting in Callahan's Passage, where casualty rates accelerated past thirty-six hundred dead in two hours without base ownership changing hands. Further out, Oarbreaker logged three transitions at Grisly Refuge within the past six hours, while formerly contentious sectors in Mooring County and the Dead Lands have fallen quiet.
